content_blocks.heading: How should you evaluate a Kama Ayurveda offer?
content_blocks.body: Confirm the exact Kama Ayurveda product or ritual bundle on the official site, check ingredients, size and usage directions, and review the final cart total. Test any promo code in checkout and verify shipping, gift-with-purchase and return terms before paying.

items.title: Ritual bundle: verify what's included
items.body: Before buying a bundle, confirm the exact products, sizes, and included gifts. A ritual name alone does not tell you the full cart value or suitability for your routine.

items.title: Ingredient-sensitive purchase: check the label
items.body: If you have allergies, sensitivities, or specific ingredient requirements, check the exact product ingredient list and usage directions. Do not rely on legacy or summary claims.

items.title: Offer checking: confirm thresholds in cart
items.body: Gift-with-purchase, free shipping and promo codes can be threshold- or SKU-specific. Only count them when the official cart shows them for your selected items.
